notes: Added missing core logic, API/facade integration, and test coverage stories for FEAT-4.

STORY-FEAT4-042.title: Implement Core NPI Registry Lookup Logic
STORY-FEAT4-042.description: Build core service logic to call CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider data (name, taxonomy, address, identifiers), and normalize into the defined provider detail schema.

STORY-FEAT4-043.title: Integrate Provider Detail Service with EvaluateCare Facade
STORY-FEAT4-043.description: Wire provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade to orchestrate lookup requests and return structured responses for downstream tool consumption.

STORY-FEAT4-044.title: Add Input Validation Model for Provider Detail Lookup
STORY-FEAT4-044.description: Define and enforce Pydantic input model for provider detail lookup (e.g., NPI required, optional metadata) to ensure safe tool invocation and consistent validation.
STORY-FEAT4-044.evidence: GAP: No explicit provider detail tool model found; required to align with existing tool_models pattern for validation.

STORY-FEAT4-045.title: Implement Provider Detail Service Unit Tests
STORY-FEAT4-045.description: Create unit tests for provider_detail_service covering NPI lookup success, missing provider handling, API failure fallback, and link enrichment correctness.

STORY-FEAT4-046.title: End-to-End Integration Test via Tool Router
STORY-FEAT4-046.description: Validate full flow from tool invocation through tool_router, facade, and provider_detail_service ensuring correct response structure and safe handling in chat loop.
